notes: v3.65.49 (So Thu-Chi ho - Sep: 'tach chi ho ra theo cac loai tien goc: moi loai 1 cot'): opExportExcel() gio gom du lieu thanh ENTRY truoc, tu do biet het cac loai tien Chi ho THAT SU co trong dot xuat (khong co dinh so cot), dung cot 'Chi <tien>' cho tung loai (VD 'Chi VND', 'Chi USD'), moi dong Chi chi dien dung vao cot tien cua no, cot khac de trong. Thu van giu 1 cot chung (Sep chi yeu cau tach Chi). Cap nhat toan bo chi so cot dong theo so cot Chi thuc te: do rong cot, merge tieu de, autofilter, dinh dang so, va truyen colIdx sang _opExportExcelStyled/pushTotal (van giu co che tach dong tong theo tien te tu v3.65.48 cho Phi NH/Quy doi USD - khong xung dot voi cot Chi da tach).
